# Number check for the health-check page (`health_check_text.md`)

*Generated by `scripts/final/health_check_number_check.py` from the text file (HTML comment and front matter skipped). CSV numbers are recomputed and must round to the printed value at the printed precision; ranges must contain every source value; word claims are tested as explicit conditions; text-sourced numbers must appear verbatim in the cited file ('external' = someone else's number, checked only for being quoted correctly). Growth rates are log ×100 unless the entry says otherwise.*

**Result:** 273 entries checked, 273 pass, 0 fail, 1 pass only at a rounding boundary. Uncovered numeric tokens in the text: 0.

## Borderline (pass only at the rounding boundary)

|---|---|---|---|---|
| routine annual discounts of about 1.5% | §6 | `data/explore/health_check/charts/business_price_giveback.csv` | 1.55 | borderline: half-up rounding of 1.55 gives 1.6 |
